newsitem.title: ROMANIA: ROMANIAN DIPLOMAT UNHURT AMONG LIMA HOSTAGES.
newsitem.headline: ROMANIAN DIPLOMAT UNHURT AMONG LIMA HOSTAGES.

text.p: Romania's charge d'affaires in Peru, one of more than 200 people held hostage in the Japanese ambassador's residence, was unhurt and had spoken to his family, officials said on Wednesday.
Romanian ambassador Alexandru Ionete told national radio from Lima that Octavian Filip did not feel threatened.
"He told his wife they were treated humanely and there was no reason to fear for their lives," Ionete said.
The foreign ministry said it was in constant touch with the Peruvian embassy on the state of negotiations to free the hostages held by left-wing rebels.

Filip, 40, had been attending ceremonies marking the birthday of Japan's Emperor when the rebels seized the residence. The gunmen threatened to kill the hostages unless the Peruvian government freed their jailed comrades.
